data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to discover UPI payment apps and initiate UPI payments on Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Discovers installed UPI-compatible apps on mobile devices and triggers payments using the UPI deep linking specification. On Android, it invokes specific apps via Intents and receives transaction status responses. On iOS, it relies on custom URL schemes to launch available UPI applications without transaction status feedback.
use_when: Integrating direct UPI payments in India without an intermediary payment gateway
Querying and listing installed UPI applications on a user's device
avoid_when: Requiring guaranteed cross-platform transaction verification (iOS cannot return transaction status directly)
Building payments outside India or without UPI support
strengths: Enables direct UPI app-to-app payments without payment gateway fees
Provides discovery of installed UPI applications and their display metadata
Follows official UPI Deep Linking and Proximity Integration specifications
weaknesses: iOS scheme limitations prevent identifying which app was launched or receiving transaction status
README explicitly notes it is currently working primarily in Android with specific banks
Non-merchant transactions face frequent errors and restrictions (e.g., Z7, U16 errors) from evolving bank apps
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring LSApplicationQueriesSchemes in iOS Info.plist for each supported UPI app scheme.
